st: General Armivolkoff pulls a gun on Charles and Erik at his home, and later Shaw forces him to send Soviet missiles to Cuba.

files.notes: Named on screen ('General Armivolkoff' on the phone in Moscow). The film calls him a senior Soviet official and general but never names the force; 'Soviet Armed Forces' is the app's existing name for the Soviet military (used for the animated Soviets). Tagged Compound: he is a pawn the Hellfire Club coerces, not a foe of the heroes, though he draws a gun on Charles and Erik once.

st: McCone brushes off Moira's report on Hendry, rages when Charles reads minds, and has the young mutants locked away.

files.notes: Named on screen: Moira calls him 'McCone' on the phone and he is addressed as 'John' while he and Agent Stryker watch the captive Emma Frost; he is called 'the director of the CIA'. He is also present at the end when Moira's memory is wiped ('this is why the CIA is no place for a woman').

add.k: A CIA agent with a son named William
st: Agent Stryker scoffs at Charles's mind reading, sees Raven take his shape, and later questions the captive Emma Frost.

files.notes: Named on screen: Charles answers him as 'Agent Stryker' and reads his thoughts about his son William. He is the father of the app's William Stryker (fox-stryker), a separate man. Only his surname is said, so n is 'Agent Stryker'.

add.k: A Weapon X scientist who bonded adamantium to Wolverine
st: In season 2, Dr. Cornelius runs the adamantium feed into Wolverine's bones for the Professor, until Wolverine wakes in a rage.
In season 2, Team X finds Cornelius alone in his ruined lab, where he taunts them before he mutates into one of the Brood.

files.notes: Named on screen in both: 'Dr. Cornelius, how is our patient?' (Repo Man) and 'Well, I'll be. Dr. Cornelius.' (X-Men '97 S2E5, Weapon X, Lies, and DVDs). His TAS footage is reused as recap in Out of the Past and Weapon X, Lies, and Video Tape; no new scenes, so no extra steps. 'Weapon X' is named on screen ('Weapon X scum has a new lab'). The death is per the Marvel Database (the Brood break him from inside); Wikipedia says he mutates into one of the creatures.

add.k: A mutant nurse who once loved Charles Xavier
st: In season 4, Amelia spurns Xavier on Asteroid M, then doubts Cortez's story of Magneto's death and checks the records herself.
In season 5, now a resident on Muir Island, Amelia flees the Phalanx with Beast and Forge and gets the team into their lair.
In season 1, Amelia treats the wounded in the ruins of Genosha after the Sentinel attack.

files.notes: Named on screen ('Her name is Amelia Voght', Sanctuary; 'Amelia's a first-year resident here', Phalanx Covenant II; 'Stellar work, Amelia', X-Men '97 S1E7). On Asteroid M she is a resident of Magneto's sanctuary; the screen never names a group for her there, so 'Independent'. Muir Island's research facility is named on screen; she works there as a resident. She stays there by the default rule for X-Men '97, where she works triage on Genosha.

st: In season 2, Amphibius seizes Magneto and Xavier for his new master, then fights the X-Men for Sinister until the Mutates give up.

files.notes: Named on screen by Magneto ('Amphibius!', Beauty & the Beast) and by Barbarus ('Foolish Amphibius', Reunion I). Covers Beauty & the Beast and Reunion I and II. The Marvel Database says he helps search Genosha in X-Men '97 S1E5, but the transcript does not name him and his part could not be confirmed, so no step.

add.k: A Morlock with the power to hypnotize
st: In season 1, Annalee lulls Cyclops and Jean to sleep for Callisto and makes Jean think she is her daughter, until Wolverine scares her.
In season 4, Annalee helps steal an ambulance to save the sick Leech, and Storm, Wolverine and Jubilee help revive him.

files.notes: Named on screen by Callisto ('Good work, Annalee. You'll be rewarded.', Captive Hearts). In Have Yourself a Morlock Little X-Mas she is on screen and speaks (the transcript tags her lines: 'But Leech's mutant powers were out of control'), with the ambulance theft per the Marvel Database and the transcript. Out of the Past I and II (season 3) has no step: she is only one of the captive Morlocks, with no action of her own. She works against the X-Men once (Captive Hearts) and is a sympathetic Morlock later, so Compound like the other Morlocks; Callisto's file is Raft.

st: In season 1, a shape-shifting Morlock poses as a dead Cyclops to fool the X-Men, but Wolverine smells the trick.
In season 2, chased by an anti-mutant mob, he escapes by turning himself into a trash can.
In season 4, Ape helps steal an ambulance for the dying Leech and readies a place for Wolverine's blood transfusion.
In season 1, Ape is among the Morlocks on Genosha killed in the Sentinel attack.

files.notes: First named on screen in Have Yourself a Morlock Little X-Mas ('Hurry, Ape!', overall episode 62), so the name is staged there. The season 2 step (Till Death Do Us Part I) rests on the Marvel Database character pages for Ape and Tommy; independent recaps confirm the Friends of Humanity mob chasing Morlocks in that episode with Ape on screen. The death on Genosha (X-Men '97 S1E5, Remember It) is per Wikipedia's Morlocks article. Out of the Past I and II (season 3) has no step: he is only one of the captive Morlocks, with no action of his own. Brief cameos in Secrets, Not Long Buried and Graduation Day are not given steps.

st: In season 3, Araki stands by Lilandra as the X-Men fight the Imperial Guard for Jean, and she orders him to fire on the Phoenix.
In season 1, Araki, now Lord Chancellor, warns Lilandra that her wedding to Xavier could divide the Shi'ar in their Kree war.

files.notes: Named on screen ('They will not win, Araki'; 'Araki, get the weapons online', Dark Phoenix IV; Deathbird: 'Araki sugars his words', X-Men '97 S1E6). His Beyond Good and Evil IV appearance is a silent cameo in the Shi'ar throne room as it blinks out, so it has no step.

add.k: A twin robot of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard
st: In season 3, the twin robot Warstar serves D'Ken in the Imperial Guard, then fights the X-Men on the Moon for Jean.

files.notes: Names itself on screen ('Organics are too slow to fight Warstar', Dark Phoenix IV, overall episode 43); first seen unnamed in The Phoenix Saga IV and V. The Imperial Guard is named on screen; 'The Shi'ar Imperial Guard' is the app's group file name (fox-anim-imperial-guard), as groups_in_app has no entry for it.

add.k: Trevor Fitzroy's partner from the future
st: In season 4, Bantam travels to 1959 with Fitzroy to kill Xavier for Master Mold, until a message from Fitzroy's future self stops them.

files.notes: Named on screen ('Bantam, come on!'; 'he will destroy you and Bantam'). One Man's Worth I and II. He and Fitzroy work for Master Mold on one job; the screen names no group, so 'Independent'.

st: In season 2, Barbarus turns on his creator Magneto for a new master, Sinister, until the X-Men beat Sinister and the Mutates give up.

files.notes: Named on screen by Magneto ('Barbarus! I did not create you for this!', X-Ternally Yours). Covers X-Ternally Yours and Reunion I and II.

add.k: Leader of the Assassins, once promised to Gambit
st: In season 2, Bella Donna trades Gambit's brother for him, forces a wedding and fakes the tithe, until the X-Ternal takes her powers.
In season 2, the risen Gambit lures her home and bends her mind, and she fights the X-Men for him until Rogue sets him free.

files.notes: Named on screen ('Bella Donna, leader of the Assassins', X-Ternally Yours; 'You tell me, Bella Donna', X-Men '97 S2E8, The Dead Man's Hand). 'The Assassins Guild' is said on screen in X-Men '97 ('The Assassins Guild calls upon its covenant'). In X-Men '97 she is a victim of Gambit's mind control; she is freed when Rogue frees Gambit.

add.k: A mutant who rules Skull Mesa for its gold
st: In season 4, Solarr seizes Skull Mesa's gold mine and plans to execute Cyclops, until the townsfolk rise up and take him prisoner.

files.notes: Introduces himself as Bill Braddock, then declares 'My name is Solarr!' (Secrets, Not Long Buried). Wikipedia calls his gang the Children of the Shadow, but the transcript never says that name, so 'Independent'. The townsfolk keep him to judge in Skull Mesa.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Standing in for Shaw, Emma visits Armivolkoff at his home and uses her telepathy to pry at his plans for missiles. Charles and Erik burst in and take her, and he draws a gun on them.
stages.whoA: Shaw's telepath, who reads his mind about the missiles.
stages.whoB: The Soviet general she works on for Shaw.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: In Moscow, Shaw pushes Armivolkoff to put Soviet missiles in Cuba. When the general reaches for the KGB, Shaw's crew forces him to go along.
stages.whoA: The mutant who forces him to send missiles to Cuba.
stages.whoB: The Soviet general he forces to send missiles to Cuba.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Charles and Erik break into Armivolkoff's home to seize Emma Frost. The general pulls a gun, and Charles knocks him out with his mind.
stages.whoA: A telepath who breaks into his home and knocks him out.
stages.whoB: The Soviet general he knocks out to seize Emma.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Erik storms Armivolkoff's home with Charles to grab Emma Frost. The general turns his gun on them before Charles drops him.
stages.whoA: An intruder who storms his home to grab Emma.
stages.whoB: The Soviet general whose home he raids.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: McCone hangs up on Moira when she says Colonel Hendry was at the Hellfire Club, and scoffs at her talk of mutants. At the end, when she remembers nothing, he says the CIA is no place for a woman.
stages.whoA: The agent he doubts at every turn.
stages.whoB: Her director, who dismisses her warnings.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Moira brings Charles to the CIA to warn about Shaw. When Charles reads minds and reveals secrets about the missiles, McCone calls him a spy and orders the mutants locked down.
stages.whoA: A mind reader he calls a spy and wants locked up.
stages.whoB: The CIA director who calls him a spy.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: McCone and Agent Stryker sit together when Charles and Raven show their powers. Later they watch the captive Emma Frost and talk about a coming war with mutants.
stages.whoA: A fellow CIA man who watches the captive Emma with him.
stages.whoB: His director at the CIA.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: With Emma Frost held at the CIA, McCone and Stryker wonder aloud about a war with mutants. She cuts the glass and tells them it would not be a war, since humans could not win.
stages.whoA: The captive telepath who mocks his talk of war.
stages.whoB: A CIA director whose fears she mocks.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Stryker mocks Charles as a magic act, and Charles answers by reading his thoughts about his son William. Raven then takes Stryker's own shape to prove mutants are real.
stages.whoA: A telepath who reads his thoughts about his son.
stages.whoB: A doubting CIA agent whose mind he reads.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: To prove mutants exist, Raven turns into a copy of Agent Stryker in front of the CIA. She asks if that was a good enough magic trick.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who copies his face to prove a point.
stages.whoB: The doubting agent whose shape she takes.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Stryker and McCone hold Emma Frost behind glass at the CIA and talk of war with mutants. She mocks them, saying humans could never win.
stages.whoA: The captive telepath who mocks him.
stages.whoB: A CIA agent holding her prisoner.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine relives the Weapon X lab, where Dr. Cornelius runs the adamantium feed into his bones. Wolverine fights back and breaks loose.
stages.whoA: The scientist who bonded metal to his bones.
stages.whoB: The test subject he filled with adamantium.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Wolverine gathers his old Team X to find a new Weapon X lab and kill Cornelius. They find him alone among the Brood, and he taunts them before he mutates.
stages.whoA: The Weapon X scientist he hunts down.
stages.whoB: His old subject, who comes to kill him.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: When Team X finds Cornelius, Yuriko calls him a thief who perverted her father's work. He sneers that Professor Oyama's science was junk.
stages.whoA: Oyama's daughter, who wants him dead.
stages.whoB: The man who stole her father's work.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Sabretooth joins Team X to bury Cornelius and the people who made them killers. When they find him, Sabretooth claims him for himself.
stages.whoA: A Weapon X victim who wants to kill him.
stages.whoB: The Weapon X scientist he wants to kill.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amelia once nursed Charles in India, and they fell in love before the X-Men drove them apart. On Asteroid M she spurns him, but after Cortez falls she turns down his offer to join him on good terms.
stages.whoA: Charles, the man she loved and left over his X-Men.
stages.whoB: Amelia, the nurse he loved and lost.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amelia visits the captive Gambit after Cortez tortures him, and he plants doubts about Magneto's death. She sets out to find the truth about Cortez.
stages.whoA: The captive X-Man who makes her doubt Cortez.
stages.whoB: The Asteroid M resident who checks on him in his cell.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cortez threatens Amelia when she tries to stop him torturing Gambit. She grows sure he lied about Magneto and goes looking for proof.
stages.whoA: The new leader of Asteroid M, who threatens her.
stages.whoB: A resident who stops trusting him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Asteroid M, Beast and Xavier come to see Magneto's dream and find Amelia there. Later Beast reaches Muir Island, where Amelia helps him fight the Phalanx and leads them to Magneto.
stages.whoA: Hank McCoy, who works beside her against the Phalanx.
stages.whoB: Amelia, who helps him fight the Phalanx.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Amelia runs triage among the wounded in Genosha's ruins, and Hank comes to see the damage. She praises him and talks about what the first days were like.
stages.whoA: Hank McCoy, who visits her triage in Genosha.
stages.whoB: Amelia, who treats Genosha's wounded.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amelia takes up medicine again as a first-year resident at Moira's Muir Island facility. When the Phalanx attack, she flees the island with Moira and the others.
stages.whoA: Moira, who runs the Muir Island facility where she trains.
stages.whoB: A first-year resident at her facility.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amphibius once served Magneto, who made him a Mutate. Now he seizes Magneto and Xavier for his new master and helps hold them in Sinister's citadel.
stages.whoA: His creator, whom he captures for a new master.
stages.whoB: A Mutate he made, who turns on him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amphibius drags Xavier and Magneto through the swamp as prisoners, and the Mutates catch them again at their plane. He fights the X-Men who come to save Xavier.
stages.whoA: A captive he hauls off to Sinister.
stages.whoB: A Mutate who takes him prisoner.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amphibius serves the new master of the Savage Land, Sinister, who holds Xavier and Magneto in his citadel. When the X-Men beat Sinister, the Mutates give up.
stages.whoA: His master in the Savage Land.
stages.whoB: A Mutate who serves him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amphibius and Barbarus both turn on their creator Magneto and serve Sinister. Together they ambush Xavier and Magneto and fight the X-Men.
stages.whoA: A fellow Mutate who serves Sinister with him.
stages.whoB: A fellow Mutate who serves Sinister with him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Magneto made Barbarus a Mutate, but Barbarus tells him the Mutates now follow a new master. He attacks Magneto and Xavier and later helps capture them for Sinister.
stages.whoA: His creator, whom he turns on.
stages.whoB: A Mutate he made, who turns on him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Barbarus attacks the powerless Xavier and Magneto in the Savage Land and later subdues them by their wrecked plane. He fights the X-Men who come for Xavier.
stages.whoA: A prisoner he takes to Sinister.
stages.whoB: A Mutate who hunts him down.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Barbarus serves Sinister, the new master of the Savage Land, and brings him Xavier and Magneto. When the X-Men beat Sinister, the Mutates give up.
stages.whoA: His new master.
stages.whoB: A Mutate who serves him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ka-Zar fights the Mutates who enslave his people. Barbarus springs a trap in Magneto's secret passage, and Ka-Zar escapes to try again.
stages.whoA: The jungle lord who fights the Mutates.
stages.whoB: A Mutate who enslaves his people.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Annalee serves Callisto, using her hypnosis to put Cyclops and Jean to sleep so the Morlocks can take them. Callisto praises her and promises a reward.
stages.whoA: The leader of the Morlocks.
stages.whoB: A Morlock who hypnotizes for her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Annalee lulls Jean to sleep for Callisto and then makes her believe she is Annalee's daughter. When Wolverine scares Annalee off, her hold on Jean breaks.
stages.whoA: An X-Man she makes into her daughter.
stages.whoB: The Morlock who hypnotizes her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Annalee and Ape are both Morlocks under Callisto. When Leech falls sick, the two steal an ambulance to get him help.
stages.whoA: A fellow Morlock who helps her steal an ambulance.
stages.whoB: A fellow Morlock who steals an ambulance with him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Annalee and the Morlocks refuse Storm's offer to live at the mansion. Later, when Leech is dying, Storm stops the ambulance chase and helps save him.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who helps save Leech.
stages.whoB: A Morlock she helps save Leech.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ape serves Callisto, posing as Cyclops to fool the X-Men while she keeps the real one. Later he helps her Morlocks when the young Leech falls ill.
stages.whoA: The leader of the Morlocks.
stages.whoB: A shape-shifting Morlock who serves her.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Ape lives on Genosha with Callisto and the Morlocks. Both die when the Sentinels attack the island.
stages.whoA: The leader of the Morlocks.
stages.whoB: A Morlock who dies on Genosha with her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Disguised as Cyclops, Ape tries to fool the X-Men, but Wolverine smells a Morlock. Later Wolverine gives his blood to save Leech while Ape gets things ready.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who sees through his disguise, then saves Leech.
stages.whoB: The Morlock who fakes Cyclops, then helps save Leech.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ape fights the X-Men when Storm comes for Cyclops. Later Storm finds him stealing an ambulance for Leech and gives him orders to help Wolverine save the boy.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who helps the Morlocks save Leech.
stages.whoB: A Morlock she sends to help save Leech.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Araki stands by Lilandra as she puts Jean on trial and the X-Men fight the Imperial Guard. When the Phoenix rises, she orders him to fire the weapons.
stages.whoA: His empress, whom he advises.
stages.whoB: Her chief adviser.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: As Lilandra announces she will marry Xavier, Araki gently warns that a royal wedding could divide the Shi'ar during the Kree war. Deathbird mocks him for softening his words.
stages.whoA: His empress, whom he has known since she was young.
stages.whoB: Her Lord Chancellor, who doubts the wedding.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: At Lilandra's court, Araki raises his doubts about the wedding politely. Deathbird scoffs that he sugars his words and says plainly what he only hints.
stages.whoA: Lilandra's sister, who mocks his caution.
stages.whoB: The Lord Chancellor she mocks.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Warstar serves Emperor D'Ken in the Imperial Guard as he hunts for the M'Kraan Crystal. It fights the X-Men and Starjammers for him.
stages.whoA: The emperor it serves.
stages.whoB: A robot of his Imperial Guard.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Under Lilandra, Warstar is one of the Imperial Guard sent to fight the X-Men on the Moon for Jean. It boasts that organics are too slow to beat it.
stages.whoA: The empress it fights for.
stages.whoB: A robot of her Imperial Guard.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bantam travels back to 1959 with Fitzroy to kill the young Xavier for Master Mold. A message from Fitzroy's future self stops them, and the two flee to the future.
stages.whoA: The man he goes back in time to kill.
stages.whoB: A time traveler sent to kill him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bishop chases Fitzroy and Bantam through time to stop them killing Xavier. He plays Fitzroy a message from his future self, and the pair flee back to the future.
stages.whoA: The time traveler who chases them.
stages.whoB: Fitzroy's partner, whom he chases through time.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine teams with Bishop to stop Fitzroy and Bantam from killing Xavier. They fight Bantam and Nimrod along the way.
stages.whoA: An X-Man who fights him across time.
stages.whoB: Fitzroy's partner, whom he fights.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bella Donna was meant to marry Remy, and she trades his kidnapped brother for him to force the wedding. She hands the Thieves a fake tithe, but Gambit exposes her.
stages.whoA: Remy, the thief she was promised to.
stages.whoB: Bella Donna, the Assassin he was promised to.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Remy, back from the dead, invites Bella Donna home and bends her mind to serve him. She fights the X-Men for him until Rogue frees him.
stages.whoA: Her thieving ex, back from the dead.
stages.whoB: The ex he invites home and controls.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bella Donna gives the Thieves a fake tithe so the X-Ternal will destroy them. Jean shows the X-Ternal the truth, and she strips Bella Donna's powers.
stages.whoA: The X-Ternal, who strips her powers.
stages.whoB: The Assassin who tries to trick her.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Under Gambit's control, Bella Donna fights the X-Men when Rogue comes looking for him. Rogue frees Gambit, and his hold on Bella Donna ends.
stages.whoA: Rogue, who frees Gambit and breaks his hold on her.
stages.whoB: One of Gambit's controlled followers.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Solarr has Scott's plane shot down near Skull Mesa and warns him to leave. When Scott keeps looking for Dr. Prescott, Solarr plans to burn him in public, but the town turns on Solarr.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he tries to execute.
stages.whoB: The mutant tyrant of Skull Mesa.

dropped.why: His name is never said or shown in X-Men: Days of Future Past: the transcript has only 'Mr. President' and 'the President of the United States', and no caption, sign or name plate naming him is documented. Only the credits name him Richard Nixon, so he fails the name rule (like Cameron Klein).
